args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate since the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it was not a candidate).
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the health check failures and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged. The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.
